basic_info.description: This tree-lined street is one of the best blocks in San Francisco. Quiet, with a village-like feel, 11 Divisadero is located close to the commercial areas of the Lower Haight, Duboce Triangle and the Castro as well as to lovely neighborhood parks and convenient to plenty of transportation. Oozing period charm including box beam ceilings, sweet wooden built-ins, the warmth of traditional wainscoting and a decorative fireplace. Two bedrooms and one updated bath plus an additional office space. This unit walks out directly to a fantastic shared garden, making entertaining a joy and morning coffee/afternoon sun-basking a delight. Extra deeded storage space in garage as well as 1 car parking. This home is a perfect start to a wonderful New Year! Welcome!
